name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
August 13, 2013
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Vera Bayliss, Co-president, Brother Benno’s Auxiliary
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
2013 Strawberry Festival Post Event Report by Bret Schanzenbach, Chief Executive Officer of the Vista Chamber of Commerce
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending May 31, 2013 (CC)
C4.
Design/Build Agreement for Agua Hedionda Lift Station Emergency Bypass Pump Project
(CC)
C5.
CIP No. 8227 - Buena Outfall Force Main Air Valves Award of Contract (BSD)
1.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2013- , amending the Capital Project Budget for FY 2013/14; and
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2013- , awarding a construction agreement with Piperin Corporation for the project.
C6.
CIP No. 8248 - Amendment to the Capital Improvement Program Budget for the Pedestrian Bridge Across Agua Hedionda Creek (CC)
C7.
Final Map, Reimbursement Agreement and Property Transfer for Adobe Estates (PC 14-215) (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Final Subdivision Map for Adobe Estates, consisting of 159 single family residential lots and 16 lettered lots at 1980 N. Santa Fe Avenue;
2.
Resolution No. 2013- , approving an agreement for reimbursement of design and construction costs of street improvements (Sports Park Way); and
3.
Resolution No. 2013- , authorizing the City Manager to accept grant deeds from the Vista Unified School District for the Taylor Street extension and to transfer the properties to Pulte Home Corporation.
C8.
Final Subdivision Maps for Hilo Drive (PC2-094) and Maryland Drive (PC2-105) (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Final Subdivision Map for Hilo Drive, PC2-094, consisting of nine single family residential lots at 1795 Hilo Drive; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Final Subdivision Map for Maryland Drive, PC2-105, consisting of 16 single family residential lots and one lettered lot at 1145 Maryland Drive.
C9.
Agreements for As-Needed Construction Management and Inspection Services (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2013- , with Valley Construction;
2.
Resolution No. 2013- , with EPC Consultants, Inc.; and
3.
Resolution No. 2013- , with Infrastructure Engineering Corporation.
C10.
Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Vista City Employees Association (VCEA), Letter of Agreement with the Vista City Maintenance Association (VCMA) and Management & Confidential Employee Compensation Plan Amendments (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving an MOU between the City of Vista and the VCEA and repealing all resolutions in conflict herewith.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Letter of Agreement between the City of Vista and the VCMA.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , amending the Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan and repealing all resolutions in conflict herewith.
C11.
Appointments of Youth Commissioners (CC)
C12.
Revisions to Vista Municipal Code Chapter 8.12 Smoking in Public Places (CC)
C13.
Copier Maintenance and Supplies (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Loan Payment Return Agreement and Grant Agreement (CC/SA)
1.
Adopt the following resolutions, approving an agreement returning to the Vista Successor Agency a sum received by the City in 2011 as a loan repayment from the Vista Redevelopment Agency:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- ; and
b.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013- .
2.
Adopt the following resolutions, approving a grant agreement providing funds to the Successor Agency to the Vista Redevelopment Agency for partial payment of its due diligence payment:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- ; and
b.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013- .
PUBLIC HEARINGS
Recommended Action:
No Public Hearings are scheduled.*3
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
